sv.title: Kursraketen letar efter sina ägare
sv.summary: Teknikföretaget Sivers Semiconductor, verksamt inom bland annat fotonik, har problem med att få i ihop en valberedning då en stor del av bolagets aktier ägs anonymt.

en.title: Share rocket looks for its owners
en.summary: Technology company Sivers Semiconductor, active in photonics among other areas, is having trouble assembling a nomination committee because a large part of the company's shares are owned anonymously.
